name: Old Port Authority
summary: In Booty Bay, the Old Port Authority draws travelers to its market stalls. Beneath its roof, they find exotic pets, firearms, hearty rations, and finely crafted weapons.

sections.title: Commerce on the Boardwalk
sections.body: Beneath Booty Bay’s boardwalks, the Old Port Authority draws brisk trade in the pirate haven. Its stalls offer supplies, firearms, bows, food, and weapons to scoundrels and privateers. Nautical imports include colorful birds and oddities from the docks, all offered to anyone with coin.

faq.q: What is the Old Port Authority?
faq.answer: In Booty Bay, the Old Port Authority is a prominent warehouse divided into several market stalls. Adventurers and buccaneers come for food, ammunition, weapons, and trade goods.
Five stalls fill the warehouse: Nautical Needs, Good Food, Swift Flights, Boomstick Imports East, and Cuts-N-Bruises Incorporated. They sell rations, weapons, pet birds, and basic provisions.
Yes. At Nautical Needs, you can acquire exotic birds such as cockatiels and Senegal parrots. Local sailors and privateers favor them as companions.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can restock shot and powder at Boomstick Imports East before heading into Stranglethorn’s deep jungles.
At Good Food, you can find regional cooking ingredients and provisions brought by trading vessels passing through.
